grammar.summary: 本课学习 there be 的过去式与一般过去时描述赛事。

points.title: There was / There were
points.explanation: 过去存在的场景用 there be 的过去式：单数/不可数用 was，复数用 were。There were hundreds of people at the race.

examples.en: There was a car race near our town last year.
examples.cn: 去年我们镇附近有一场汽车比赛。

examples.en: There were twenty cars in the race.

points.title: last 表过去时间
points.explanation: last year / last week / last Sunday 都是过去时间标志，谓语用过去式。

examples.en: My wife and I were at the race.
